note: First published schema of the detached runner's job record nexus-job (BG-1), generated from JobRecordDocument in cli/src/core/runner_store.ts on release/v1.3.0. The record carries its version in the member 'version'; this ledger keys it as schema_version like the other ledgers. Nothing was published before it. The reader refuses a record of any other version, so every added, removed or changed member bumps JOB_RECORD_VERSION.

BG-3: a job's `origin` gains the variant {kind: trigger, triggerId, eventId, eventKind, approvedSha256}, for a job an approved event trigger fired. Version stays 1: the variants the previous entry published are unchanged and no release carried BG-1 before this, so no published reader meets the new one.
